children: Higher FY28 electricity prices in October have made Morgan Stanley incrementally positive about the risk to consensus earnings forecasts for Origin Energy and AGL Energy. Still, it's keeping underweight calls on both stocks. Market participants attribute plant outages, El Niño, higher forward coal prices, and AI load growth to the rise in forward power prices, MS says. MS highlights that FY28 base load strip prices are up A$16/MWh in New South Wales state so far this quarter compared to the three months through September. Volatility spiked in October. Prices are also higher in Victoria state. Despite no change to its bearish calls, MS prefers Origin over AGL. (david.winning@wsj.com; @dwinningWSJ)
